statement: The WiiBrew Wiimote Data Reporting section describes output report 0x12 selecting continuous data reports when its designated flag is set and change-driven reporting otherwise, and requiring report mode selection again after extension connection/disconnection stops streaming. This provides a device-side protocol reference but no measured report-per-second cadence.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew oldid 123257 Data Reporting / mode selection and hotplug reset; avoid deriving clock-period requirements.
